info.title: StepIt Camera web server
info.description: The web server of StepIt Camera, the program `web_server`: the test page, the pictures the driver saved in its folder of pictures, `download_directory`, and what that folder holds. Every response allows any origin, so that a page served elsewhere can read the pictures too. It has no password: it serves anyone on the network.

tags.name: Pictures
tags.description: The pictures the driver saved, and the folders they are in.

tags.name: Page
tags.description: The test page, and this description.

get.description: A file of the folder of pictures, at its path relative to it, e.g. `IMG_0042.CR2` or `2026-10-06/IMG_0042.CR2`. A `Range` request reads only a part of it, e.g. the JPEG preview inside a RAW file. A path outside the folder of pictures, e.g. with `..`, is not found.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The picture's path in the folder of pictures, folders and all.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: Only these bytes of the file, e.g. `bytes=0-65535`.

206.description: The bytes asked for. `Content-Range` says which, and how large the file is, e.g. `bytes 0-65535/25843210`.

Content-Range.description: The bytes sent, and the file's size.

404.description: No such file in the folder of pictures.

get.description: What the folder of pictures holds: its folders, and its files with their sizes and when they changed. Hidden files and folders, whose name starts with a dot, e.g. a file still being written under a temporary name, are left out.

What a folder of the pictures holds, as for `/pictures/`. The path ends with a slash: without it, the path names a file. A folder outside the folder of pictures, even through a link, or a hidden one, is not found.

parameters.name: folder
parameters.description: The folder's path in the folder of pictures, e.g. `2026-10-06` or `2026-10-06/series_01`.

404.description: No such folder in the folder of pictures.

get.description: The camera's test page, once it is built; the files it loads are served the same way, by their paths.

404.description: The test page is not built.

get.summary: This description, to read and try
get.description: A Swagger UI page of this description. The browser loads Swagger UI itself from cdn.jsdelivr.net.

recursive.name: recursive
recursive.description: `1` or `true`: everything below the folder, in one answer, the paths relative to it.

folder.description: The folder listed, relative to the folder of pictures; empty for the folder of pictures itself.

folders.description: Its folders, their paths relative to it, sorted.

path.description: The file's path, relative to the folder listed.

modified.description: When it last changed, in ISO 8601 and UTC.
